# In-place Recorder salvage plan

## Baseline and constraints

Plan from current committed `HEAD` **`6fbf3d627e59d02339c5c7cb7b637c6511f054c4`**, a strict forward descendant of the adjudicated `e859b7b…`; `6fbf3d6` adds only the required incomplete-Apply disposition. Preserve the intentional dirty Recorder construction and repair its existing `src/recorder/` seam. Do not restart from another branch, introduce a second archive/cold/session mechanism, inspect archived session payloads, rewrite history, or synthesize a Coder Receipt. Preserve `.ak/dockets/issues/10/apply/apply-001/coder-incomplete.json` as the missing Coder Receipt disposition and preserve all migration/history bytes.

Relevant history contains no committed Recorder implementation to imitate; existing package/role lifecycle seams are the reusable pattern. Current executable evidence: `npm run typecheck` fails at `src/recorder/extract.ts` under `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`; focused Recorder tests are 26/27 here (signal converted to exit 143); full testing was started but is too long for the planning window, while the Judge’s fixed evidence records 284/286 with the additional packed inventory snapshot failure. Apply must first convert every Judge counterexample below into ordinary regression coverage, then repair the owning seam rather than add probes or hooks.

## 1. Restore executable proof

**Behavior** — Correct optional-property construction without weakening compiler settings; establish a truthful green baseline for typecheck, focused Recorder tests, full regression tests, and packed inventory.

**Owner** — `src/recorder/extract.ts`, existing `test/recorder-*.test.ts`, and the pre-existing package lifecycle snapshot/test.

**Red** — Preserve the current typecheck error, outward signal failure, and packed-file snapshot mismatch as reproducible failures. Add no assertion relaxation.

**Green** — Construct optional `usage` only when present; signal handling and inventory become green through the substantive fixes below; all exact final gates pass.

**Scope** — No compiler relaxation, AC change, test deletion, or unrelated cleanup.

## 2. Bind Receipt/audit extraction to package acceptance

**Behavior** — Replace recursive/bare/“last successful result wins” extraction with one ordered lifecycle decoder shared by only the two supported persisted-session and machine envelopes. A candidate requires an assistant-issued terminating package call, matching execution-start event, and exactly one matching successful terminal acceptance (exact tool name, call id, accepted text/details); reject orphan/replayed/conflicting/duplicate/out-of-order/error/mismatched/prose/unsupported/ambiguous events. Absence remains lawful. Audit pass/usage is copied only from a genuinely bound accepted Judge/Reviewer lifecycle; never infer `auditPassed` from tool identity or exit success. Distinguish Collector generated result from its accepted terminal result. Scan accepted details, revalidate derivatives, and fail if redaction damages the discriminant/type.

**Owner** — A narrow package-owned leaf contract/registry (constants, output types, exact validators) shared by Coder/Fixer, Reviewer, Judge, Collector, and `src/recorder/extract.ts`; role registration/model/help modules retain behavior but consume/re-export leaves. Collector’s accepted-receipt validator must recursively and exactly validate reports, legs, attempts, snapshots, evidence records, discriminants, links, and closed shapes using package-owned production contracts—not merely top-level arrays. Recorder must not import/load full role or Pi registration surfaces.

**Red** — Lifecycle tables for all five tools in both envelopes: valid acceptance, generated-vs-accepted Collector output, no result, malformed details/discriminants, sanitized lawful/unlawful derivative, orphan result, missing/mismatched start or call, replay, out-of-order event, error terminal, unsupported envelope, prose/bare lookalike, duplicate identical terminal, and conflicting terminals. Explicitly retain the forged orphan Judge and `[null]`/arbitrary Collector counterexamples.

**Green** — Exactly one unambiguous production-accepted lifecycle yields one typed Receipt; only bound Judge/Reviewer acceptance can carry package-observed audit facts; all forgeries and malformed Collector descendants fail or yield lawful absence as specified. Module-load tracing proves Recorder startup does not load role registration/model/help.

**Scope** — Repair existing extraction and role-contract seams only; no generic session archive, test parser, model classifier, second Receipt builder, or fabricated Coder Receipt.

## 3. Close the credential boundary

**Behavior** — Route every promotable/generated key and value and the entire public failure object through one fail-closed scanner. Detect redacted-key collisions before object construction and reject type-invalid sanitized derivatives. Public diagnostic codes/messages are fixed non-secret literals; attacker-controlled argv/path/config/error text is never interpolated. On child+Recorder failure retain one bounded, scanned child diagnostic separately from byte-exact tee output. Extend bounded patterns to representative `sk-proj-`, `sk-ant-`, `glpat-`, `xoxb-`, `AIza…` forms as well as every authority-mandated credential class. Build the redaction report from the final scan closure so manifest/report cannot diverge.

**Owner** — `src/recorder/scanner.ts` as the single scanner, `errors.ts` as the fixed public serializer, and promotion/storing/manifest callers as scanner clients.

**Red** — A category × credential matrix injects every mandated class into argv, cwd/environment, archive/reference repository/path/config metadata, provenance, accepted Receipt/audit, external/exhibit bytes, generated receipt/audit/manifest/report keys and values, and Recorder/child diagnostics. Include key-collision and unlawful derivative cases. Assert absence from stage, final core, redaction report, manifest, and failure JSON.

**Green** — No injected secret enters any promotable or public Recorder artifact; reports contain only rule id/structural location/count; collisions and invalid derivatives fail 125 with one scanned JSON line. Child stdout/stderr remain byte-for-byte caller-owned output, explicitly not semantic DLP.

**Scope** — Bounded pattern scanning only; no semantic-DLP claim and no mutation/suppression of the child tee.

## 4. Repair admission and manifest law

**Behavior** — Resolve archive and reference roots through Git’s canonical worktree identity (`rev-parse --show-toplevel`/worktree checks), require exact equality with the selected canonical root, and reject Git administrative destinations including `.git`. Verify one exact path as mode `100644|100755`, type `blob`, and exact path/OID/hash—never the first recursive descendant. Require full resolvable commits, reject untracked/dirty bytes as references, duplicate IDs/canonical identities/copies, reserved generated IDs/paths, generated-as-future references, and external/exhibit bytes already committed in their containing repository. Require authority and task declarations. Each artifact has exactly one reference XOR stored identity; references and stored paths are canonical and unique; receipt/audit links and child exit/signal combinations are coherent.

**Owner** — `config.ts`/`paths.ts` for canonical worktree/path/ID law, `admit.ts` for exact Git/reference/stored identity and duplicate/committed-copy checks, `manifest.ts` plus `schemas/recorder-manifest-v1.schema.json` for emitted law.

**Red** — Add future/unresolvable/short commits, directory-as-blob, wrong object type/path/mode/OID/hash, dirty/untracked reference, missing authority/task, cross-repository success and confusion, duplicate canonical reference/copy, reserved ID, committed external copy, generated-as-future reference, malformed path/hash/SHA, both/neither identity, incoherent receipt/audit link, unlawful exited/signaled pair, and post-manifest redaction-hit cases. Capture HEAD/index/status before/after.

**Green** — Exact committed blobs are references only; lawful new dirty/untracked bytes enter only once through stored-artifact declarations; every real emitted manifest validates mechanically against the tightened schema; final manifest and persisted report contain the same complete hit set; Git HEAD/index/status are unchanged.

**Scope** — Recorder validates mechanical declaration law, not semantic sufficiency/truth/authority; it performs no Git mutation.

## 5. Make the transaction real

**Behavior** — Replace swallowed `safeRm` with checked required raw cleanup before promotion. Any cleanup failure yields one scanned JSON diagnostic, status 125, no final/partial manifest, and no promotion. Place scratch/stage canonically outside the selected worktree, or mechanically prove their canonical location ignored before spawning. Immediately before promotion revalidate every destination parent against symlink escape and use atomic create-if-absent/no-overwrite semantics robust to races and child-created collisions. Failure cleanup is best effort only after the required raw-cleanup decision and cannot create an apparently complete docket. Preserve exact child exit status; after successful archive, re-raise child signal through both TypeScript CLI and installed launcher rather than turning it into `128+signal`. Launcher failures use fixed sanitized JSON.

**Owner** — `run.ts` transaction state machine, `paths.ts` final parent validation, `spawn.ts` one-spawn/binary tees, `errors.ts` failure serialization, and `bin/ak-docket-record.js` installed signal boundary.

**Red** — Black-box processes/filesystems only (no production hooks): stdin inheritance; large/binary separate byte-exact stdout/stderr; invocation counter = 1; child nonzero and signal with successful promotion; child+Recorder dual failure with bounded scanned diagnostic; config/admission/scan failure; child-created destination symlink/collision; non-ignored scratch risk; real cleanup failure; real promotion failure; ordinary cleanup; race/no-overwrite; and unchanged HEAD/index/status. Assert no final or partial manifest on every Recorder failure.

**Green** — Success promotes only after complete stage + required raw cleanup, emits no Recorder diagnostic, and preserves exact child exit/signal semantics. Every Recorder failure has precedence, emits exactly one lawful scanned line, exits 125, leaves no apparently complete docket, and never overwrites an existing identity.

**Scope** — Retain documented abrupt-OS-crash residue risk; no parallel transaction/archive subsystem and no test-only failure injection.

## 6. Finish packaging without altering role surfaces

**Behavior** — Choose and document a standalone Node/runtime strategy, update `package.json` and `package-lock.json` consistently, preserve executable bin mode, and ensure packed installation invokes `node_modules/.bin/ak-docket-record` with stdin, stream, nonzero, and signal semantics. Update the existing Reviewer tarball inventory expectation only for intentional bin/schema/Recorder files. Keep role/model/help and Collector snapshots unchanged. Synchronize README grammar, worktree/Git/path law, trust limits, scanner limits, derivative semantics, child tee limitation, crash residue, transaction/outcome law, and caller commit/rotation/retention duties.

**Owner** — `package.json`, `package-lock.json`, executable `bin/`, package lifecycle/integration tests, and `README.md`.

**Red** — Packed consumer `.bin` test covers missing runtime/dependency, mode, stdin, binary streams, one invocation, exit and signal; inventory and module-load assertions fail on missing files or role-surface loading.

**Green** — Clean tarball install works without repository-local dependency leakage; lockfile matches the selected strategy; executable mode survives; expected inventory is exact; role/model/help/Collector behavior and snapshots remain stable; startup dependency tracing excludes registration/model/help modules.

**Scope** — No npm publication, role surface change, duplicated launcher mechanism, or posture-fixture audit.

## 7. Reconstruction evidence and closure

**Behavior** — Preserve all historical migration files and `coder-incomplete.json`; append exactly one final reconstruction report with reproducible command/output facts for recorded-default ancestry, retained-byte seal equality, omission dispositions, no newly introduced generic session/tool-event exhaust in issue-10 or reconstructed ancestry (excluding any content audit of pre-existing posture fixtures), mergeability, and exact final tracked logical bytes for the whole candidate tree and `.ak/dockets/issues/10`. Supersede the earlier `224089` copied-subset figure by labeling it historical, not rewriting it.

**Owner** — New append-only file under `.ak/dockets/issues/10/migration/v3-reconstruction/`; Git itself is the evidence source.

**Red** — Evidence generation fails on changed retained seal, missing disposition, non-default ancestry, prohibited newly introduced exhaust, merge conflict, dirty tree, or size mismatch.

**Green** — Report records exact SHAs, commands, results, inventories, both final byte totals, and the missing-Coder disposition; candidate is mergeable and clean with no scratch/tarball/symlink residue.

**Scope** — No archived-session inspection, `/tmp` archaeology, rewrite of historical reports/manifests, permanent size engine, generic exhaust inventory, or manufactured Receipt.

## Coherent forward commit sequence

1. **`fix(recorder): bind package acceptance contracts`** — leaf contracts/validators, exact lifecycle decoder, Collector recursive validation, extraction optional-property fix, focused lifecycle tests. Preserve role surfaces.
2. **`fix(recorder): close scan admission and manifest law`** — scanner/failure boundary, canonical Git admission, uniqueness/committed-copy law, schema and emitted-manifest validation, focused matrix tests.
3. **`fix(recorder): enforce atomic transaction outcomes`** — checked cleanup, scratch/path/promotion race law, byte-exact process behavior, signal re-raise, black-box transaction tests.
4. **`fix(package): ship standalone recorder executable`** — runtime/lockfile/bin mode, packed `.bin` matrix, exact inventory/module-load checks, README synchronization.
5. **`docs(docket): record final recorder reconstruction evidence`** — append-only final report after all implementation/package commits and gates.

Each is a new forward commit; no amend/rebase/rewrite. Before each commit inspect the staged diff and ensure only its coherent cluster is included. Final `HEAD` must be a strict descendant of `6fbf3d6…`.

## Exact final gates and cleanup

Run from the repository root after deleting the untracked `node_modules` symlink and all generated scratch/tarball/consumer residue (without deleting tracked inputs):

```bash
npm install
npm run typecheck
node --import tsx --test test/recorder-admission.test.ts test/recorder-cli.test.ts test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts test/recorder-package-lifecycle.test.ts test/recorder-transaction.test.ts
node --import tsx --test test/package-entrypoint.integration.test.ts
npm test
npm pack --dry-run --json
```

Then run report-verification commands against committed `HEAD`: canonical `git merge-base --is-ancestor <recorded-default-sha> HEAD`; retained path `git rev-parse HEAD:<path>`/byte-count/SHA-256 comparisons to the recorded inventory; omission-disposition completeness; path/name/object inspection limited to detecting newly introduced generic session/tool-event exhaust in the reconstructed issue-10 tree and ancestry (do not open archived payloads or audit posture fixtures); `git merge-tree --write-tree <default-ref> HEAD` (or repository-compatible equivalent) for mergeability; and exact tracked logical-byte sums from `git ls-tree -r -l HEAD` for both the whole tree and `.ak/dockets/issues/10`.

Finally verify:

```bash
git diff --check
git status --short
find . -maxdepth 3 \( -name '*.tgz' -o -name '*scratch*' -o -name '*consumer*' \) -print
[ ! -L node_modules ]
git merge-base --is-ancestor 6fbf3d627e59d02339c5c7cb7b637c6511f054c4 HEAD
```

Expected: every gate exits 0; focused and full counts are all green; dry-run inventory exactly matches the accepted snapshot; `git status --short` and residue search are empty; no untracked `node_modules` symlink; final report totals equal recomputation; final response gives the exact committed `HEAD`, commit list, full gate results, reconstruction facts, and explicit statement that no Coder Receipt was manufactured.
